acceptance.given: Detached negative Probe execution is requested and its command and fixture are available.

oracle.expected: Execution evidence records a separately spawned process for the negative Probe with command identity and captured result.
forbidden: The Probe runs only in-process or as a simulation.
oracle.observable: A process-execution evidence record shows a distinct child-process identity and captured negative-case result.

acceptance.then: The detached negative Probe has executed as an independent process.
acceptance.when: Run the detached negative Probe through the repository process executor and inspect execution evidence.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the detached negative Probe process-execution check and require evidence of a distinct spawned process and captured result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Execute the detached negative Probe as a real independent process and record process-boundary evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent schema change; rollback restores prior probe execution behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A ready detached negative Probe becomes executed with independently captured process evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Evidence contains a child-process identity distinct from the evaluator and a captured negative-case result.

acceptance.given: The candidate validator for FR-3 and independent verification inputs are available.

oracle.expected: An independent compatibility verification artifact records the check, inputs, and outcome.
forbidden: Compatibility is accepted without an independent verification result.
The result is only the candidate validator's unbound self-report.
oracle.observable: A structured compatibility artifact produced by a separate check references the candidate validator and checked contract.

acceptance.then: Compatibility has an independently produced verification result.
acceptance.when: Run the independent compatibility check and inspect its structured result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the FR-3 compatibility verification and require a separate structured result tied to the candidate validator and contract.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require compatibility to be established by an independent verification path with a structured artifact.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema migration; rollback removes the independent compatibility gate.

slice_hint.state_transition: Compatibility moves from pending verification to an independently evidenced result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The artifact identifies the candidate validator, checked compatibility contract, and independent outcome.

acceptance.given: The three named evaluation-seed occurrences and FR-6 classification rules are available.

oracle.expected: Each named occurrence appears exactly once with provenance, applicability, missing-label handling, counterexample or explicit absence, and an approved non-baseline classification.
forbidden: An occurrence is missing or duplicated.
An occurrence is baseline or unapproved.
Required provenance or applicability fields are absent.
oracle.observable: The manifest contains one complete approved non-baseline record for each named occurrence.

acceptance.then: Every named evaluation-seed occurrence has an approved non-baseline classification.
acceptance.when: Validate the evaluation-seed manifest against the FR-6 occurrence and classification rules.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the FR-6 manifest validator and require exactly one complete approved non-baseline record for each named occurrence.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce complete, unique, provenance-bearing, approved non-baseline classification for all three named occurrences.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Manifest validation compatibility is preserved; rollback restores prior rules.

slice_hint.state_transition: Seed occurrence records move from unverified to validated approved non-baseline records.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation passes only when all three occurrences are present exactly once with required provenance and classification.

acceptance.given: A reference coverage result and pinned evaluation inputs are available and a fresh checkout can be prepared.

oracle.expected: The fresh-checkout evaluation produces a coverage result equal to the reference result after rebuilding and reusing the original binding identity.
forbidden: The fresh-checkout coverage differs from the reference.
The result cannot be reproduced from pinned inputs.
Replay uses a changed binding identity.
oracle.observable: A reproducibility comparison records equal coverage results, pinned inputs, and the rebuilt original binding identity.

acceptance.then: The fresh-checkout run reproduces the reference coverage result using pinned inputs and the original binding identity.
acceptance.when: In a fresh checkout, rebuild the original binding identity, replay with that same identity, and compare coverage to the reference.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the fresh-checkout reproducibility evaluator and compare coverage after original-identity reconstruction and same-identity replay.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make fresh-checkout evaluation reproducible by rebuilding and reusing the original binding identity before comparing coverage.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent schema change; rollback restores prior replay behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A fresh-checkout evaluation moves to a verified matching coverage result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Comparison passes only when original identity is rebuilt and reused and fresh coverage equals reference coverage.
